Libraries for turning PDF and PowerPoint files into slide pictures. They load
only when someone adds slides, and are served from this site so the PDF
reader's worker runs (browsers block workers from other sites).

- pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs: pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 (Apache-2.0)
- pptx-preview.umd.js: pptx-preview 1.0.7 (ISC)
- modern-screenshot.js: modern-screenshot 4.7.0 (MIT)
